title: Accurate note-save feedback and readable code direction
summary: Aligns note feedback with successful device writes, keeps source code left-to-right, and removes an assumed identity from the sign-in greeting.

changes.detail: Notes no longer always claim saved while a write is pending; recall copy points to save status.
Sign-in greeting is neutral before authentication; existing owner attribution retained.
Explicit LTR direction for web source editor independently of Arabic interface.

validation.name: Source and visual audit
validation.detail: Fresh sign-in, lesson and teacher screenshots inspected. Found fixed-name greeting and unconditional saved wording.

validation.name: Post-change checks
validation.detail: Rebuild, regression and three-language checks pending.
